title: Efficacy and safety of Ursodeoxycholic Acid as a new therapy for the treatment of hepatorenal polycystic diseases, genetic study and determination of prognostic biomarkers
official: Efficacy and safety of Ursodeoxycholic Acid as a new therapy for the treatment of hepatorenal polycystic diseases, genetic study and determination of prognostic biomarkers.
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the therapeutic efficacy of UDCA versus placebo in patients with PLD by decreasing the total liver cyst volume (TLCV) growth (prevention of disease progression).
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age: 18 - 80 years (inclusive).
2. Diagnosed liver or hepatorenal polycystic disease and total liver volume 2000-5000 mL.
3. PLD defined as >10 liver cysts and PKD defined as: -	At least 2 kidney cysts or 1 cyst in each kidney in patients younger than 30 years.  -	At least 2 cysts in each kidney in patients aged 30-59 years old.  -	At least 4 cysts in each kidney in patients aged 60 years or older.
4. Not be candidates for intervention (aspiration or surgical intervention) at the time of inclusion.
Exclusion criteria:
1. TLV  >5000 mL
2. Chronic liver disease unrelated to PLD.
3. Intervention (aspiration or surgical intervention) in the previous 6 months.
4. Treatment with somatostatin analogues in the previous 6 months.
5. Hypersensitivity to UDCA or patients with galactose intolerance or malabsorption, or lactase deficiency.
6. Acute cholecystitis or frequent attacks of biliary colic.
7. Treatment with tolvaptan in the previous 6 months.
8. Renal dysfunction (MDRD- GFR ≤ 30 ml/min/1.73m2).
9. Use of hormonal contraceptives or estrogen supplements in the  previous 6 months.
10. Inclusion in another clinical trial while participating in this study.
11. Pregnant or lactating women, or subjects of childbearing potential who are not using an effective method of contraception.
12. History or other evidence of serious illness or any other condition that would make the patient, in the opinion of the investigator, unsuitable for the study.
13. Gastric or duodenal ulcers.
14. Use of drugs that may interact with UDCA, such as  cholestyramine or aluminum hydroxide.
15. Treatment with UDCA in the previous 6 months
